# datasintef_datahub_permission (Resource)

Grants a single permission on a datahub to a single principal (user, machine user or group): `datahub.admin` (Data Hub Owner) or `datahub.manage` (Data Hub Member). Non-authoritative: other grants on the datahub, such as the creator's owner grant, are left untouched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datasintef_datahub" "example" {
  alias       = "my-hub"
  name        = "My hub"
  description = "Example datahub"
  project_id  = "123456789-0"
}

# Make a user a Data Hub Member.
resource "datasintef_datahub_permission" "member" {
  datahub    = datasintef_datahub.example.id
  principal  = "jane.doe@example.com"
  permission = "datahub.manage"
}

# Make a machine user a Data Hub Owner until the end of the year.
resource "datasintef_datahub_permission" "ci_owner" {
  datahub    = datasintef_datahub.example.id
  principal  = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  permission = "datahub.admin"
  expires_at = "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datahub` (String) Alias of the datahub, e.g. `datasintef_datahub.example.id`.
- `permission` (String) Permission to grant: `datahub.admin` (Data Hub Owner) or `datahub.manage` (Data Hub Member). Valid values: datahub.admin, datahub.manage.
- `principal` (String) Principal to grant the permission to: a user email, or a principal ID (user, machine user, group, ...). dsn-api resolves emails to principal IDs; see `principal_id`.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Optional RFC 3339 timestamp at which the grant expires. Must be in the future. Once the grant has expired, dsn-api no longer reports it and Terraform will plan to recreate it.

### Read-Only

- `granted_at` (String) Timestamp the grant was (last) created.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the grant (datahub/principal/permission).
- `principal_id` (String) Principal ID the grant was stored under, as resolved by dsn-api.
- `principal_type` (String) Type of the principal (user, machine, azureAdGroup, externalUser, organizationEntity, workgroup, datahub).
